text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — saw a spike of 413s from the embeds route when clients sent mixed-dim batches. It looks like our splitter is fast-failing instead of routing to mixed-dim fallback. Anyone on call?

Aj Patel: @Maria can you paste a sample request? link or raw payload? :eyes: 

Maria Chen: quick snippet (sanitized):
```json
{"inputs":[[0.1,0.2,...] /* 64-dim */, [0.3,0.4,...] /* 1536-dim */]}
```
No X-Embed-Dims header present. Small batch, 2 items, ~8KB payload.

Sasha Ilyin: That's what I suspected — splitter picks single-model path then bails with 413 on dim mismatch. We intended to route small mixed-dim batches to the shape-aware fallback but rollout gating missed this case.

Theo Ramos: IIRC policy was: if mixed dims AND total_bytes < 64KB then route to small-batch service; else fastfail. Never surfaced in console or SDK.

Maria Chen: Customers see opaque 413 + "invalid payload". We should add telemetry (embed.shape.mixed_dim_fastfail) and a console hint that shows the offending shapes and a suggestion: "add X-Embed-Dims or call /preflight".

deploy-bot: canary deploy embed-splitter v3 -> prod-1 at 15:10 UTC (sha: a1b2c3).

Aj Patel: For rollout decision: options: (A) quick hotfix to fallback routing (low risk), (B) expose preflight in SDK + console (bigger). Leaning A now + B medium term.

Sasha Ilyin: Agree. Hotfix that treats tiny mixed batches as splittable is safe. Preflight API is the longer, better UX: it returns a split plan. We also need a console tooltip describing the byte vs dim quota.

Maria Chen: Also add client telemetry tag: client_dim_hint=true/false so we can measure adoption. Dashboard cards: "mixed-dim fastfail rate" and "preflight adoption by client version".

Theo Ramos: Sasha, can you own the hotfix PR today? I'll mock the console tooltip and a tooltip copy with suggested SDK snippet.

Sasha Ilyin: Yup — will open PR after stand and add extra tracing that logs sample input shapes (no raw vectors). Will include GC-friendly debug markers.

Maria Chen: Example preflight curl to add to SDK docs:
```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Embed-Preflight: 1" 
  -d '{"inputs":[[...],[...]],"client":"sdk-1.2.0"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/preflight
```

Aj Patel: I'll file tickets: console hint + dashboard card + telemetry metric. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
